requirement: Joomla quickstart provision puts the site's contract profile into its Claude Cowork component, as root, before the bind

oracle.ref: PR #1635 (fix); fix evidence: Dev, 22-23/10/2026: every new Joomla quickstart site whose component is Claude Cowork for Joomla >= 0.24.55 stopped at the bind with `contract_unavailable: cannot create .../lib/contracts/ja-fresco/j6` (the component, installed by root, fetches its profile on first use into its own code folder; the site answers the bind as www-data). Local: the fetch script run as root in php:8.1-cli over the real 0.24.55 component (root-owned) put ja-fresco/j6/1.0.4 on disk 0755/0644, readable by www-data; offline it exited 1 with `!! contract profile ja-fresco/j6/1.0.4 could not be put on disk: fetch failed: download failed: Could not resolve host: github.com`.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 11). The tests 'both quickstart roads fetch after the component install and before the bind, and stop on failure', 'a fetch that fails stops with a line naming the profile, and no bind follows it', 'a component that predates fetching bundles its profiles: nothing is done, nothing fails' and 'a fetching component gets the profile from its own release, readable by the web user' are 'ok'.
